compression.note: There is no original to hold this against. These seven items assert that the universe looks the same in every direction from here and that this makes here the centre — and the search for a first author returned nothing: no named originator, no cited publication, no earlier list that carries them. That is not a gap in our records so much as a fact about the claim. It is the part of the list that grew by restatement rather than by citation, and the hedge rule has nothing to bite on because nobody hedged it, because nobody in particular said it first. The refutation therefore answers the argument on its own terms rather than its author’s: isotropy about an observer is what every observer in a homogeneous universe sees, which is why it cannot single any of them out.

ARG-E18.name: Solar-system angular-momentum distribution problem
ARG-E18.basis: A question in planetary-formation theory (magnetic braking, disc transport), not evidence about Earth's motion.

A01.name: Michelson–Morley null proves Earth is not moving
A01.note: A null ether-drift result is exactly what special relativity predicts for a moving Earth. Non-discriminating.

A02.name: Michelson–Gale / Sagnac interferometry shows a stationary Earth
A02.note: MGP predicted a 0.236 fringe shift for a rotating Earth and measured 0.230 ± 0.005. It detected the rotation and returned the rate to ~2%. Cited backwards. Geocentrist Malcolm Bowden concedes the measurement in Journal of Creation 16(2), 2002.

A03.name: “Airy's failure” — water-filled telescope shows no Earth motion
A03.originator_work: De Labore Solis: Airy's Failure Reconsidered
A03.real_source: G. B. Airy 1871, Proc. Roy. Soc. London, pp. 35–39
A03.note: CAREFUL CASE. The null is the predicted result — first via Fresnel's dragging coefficient, then via special relativity: aberration depends on relative source-observer velocity, not on a medium downstream of it. The phrase 'Airy's failure' is internal to the movement; Bouw credits van der Kamp with it. Aberration existing at all is itself evidence Earth moves.

A04.name: Stellar aberration is optical/parallax, not Earth's motion
A04.note: Bouw rejected van der Kamp's version and rebuilt the model to keep aberration — an internal contradiction within the movement.

A05.name: No measurable stellar parallax
A05.originator_work: Zetetic Astronomy, 3rd ed. enl. (1881), ch. III (as “Parallax”)
A05.note: Gaia DR3 publishes parallaxes for ~1.468 billion sources at 0.02–0.03 mas for G<15. Rowbotham's own third edition prints the measurements it is cited against.

A06.name: Foucault pendulum explained by a rotating firmament
A06.note: Restates the observation in a rotating-universe frame. Non-discriminating on its own; ruled out in combination with ring-laser gyros and Michelson–Gale.

A07.name: Gyroscopes / ring-laser gyros show no Earth rotation
A07.note: Knodel's own $20,000 ring-laser gyro measured a 15°/hour drift on camera — exactly 360°÷24h. He looked for ways to shield the apparatus rather than accept the result.

A08.name: Aircraft don't compensate for spin; east/west flight times symmetric
A08.real_source: Inertial navigation systems measure Earth rate on every flight
A08.note: Descends from Rowbotham's vertical-projectile argument. The atmosphere co-moves; INS platforms explicitly correct for a ~15°/hr Earth rate.

A09.name: Coriolis effects reassigned to a rotating sky or to electromagnetism
A09.note: Frame restatement; adds no prediction the rotating model does not already make.

A10.name: No wind or drag is felt from the Earth's motion
A10.originator_work: Earth Not a Globe (3rd ed., enl.)
A10.note: Rowbotham grants that the air turns with the Earth, then argues no residual effect is felt. It is: Coriolis deflection, measured daily.

A11.name: Michelson–Pease–Pearson null result
A11.note: A high-precision repeat of Michelson–Morley (expected 0.9 fringe, measured 0.01), run by Michelson at Mount Wilson specifically to test Miller. Same non-discriminating status as A01.

A12.name: Dayton Miller detected a real aether drift that was suppressed
A12.real_source: Miller 1933, Rev. Mod. Phys. 5:203; Shankland et al. 1955, Rev. Mod. Phys. 27:167
A12.note: Shankland et al. re-examined Miller's original data sheets and traced the periodic shifts to reading statistics and local temperature variation. Shankland had been Miller's own student and colleague — which undercuts the cover-up framing.

A13.name: No centrifugal effects felt; equatorial bulge has another cause
A13.note: Centrifugal acceleration at the equator is ~0.034 m/s², about 0.3% of g — below unaided perception but routinely measured by gravimeters.

A14.name: Ballistics and artillery ignore Earth's rotation
A14.note: Long-range gunnery has corrected for Coriolis drift since WWI; naval fire-control computers did it mechanically.

A15.name: Torsion balances, gravimeters and pendulum clocks show no variation
A15.note: No specific published measurement is cited by the list.

A16.name: High-altitude balloon drift and sun-angle anomalies

A17.name: Conservation-of-momentum paradox for a moving Earth

A18.name: GPS/time-dilation corrections work in an Earth frame
A18.note: GPS corrections are computed in an Earth-centred inertial frame precisely because the Earth rotates within it.

A19.name: Gyrocompasses are sky-locked, not Earth-locked
A19.note: A gyrocompass finds true north by sensing Earth's rotation. It cannot function on a non-rotating Earth.

A20.name: Lunar laser ranging shows a fixed baseline
A20.note: No measurement cited; LLR data in fact resolve Earth rotation and lunar recession.

A21.name: Satellites and geostationary orbits reinterpreted in an Earth-fixed frame
A21.note: Shenton's Sputnik line — 'would sailing round the Isle of Wight prove it spherical?' — is the template.

A22.name: The sky's daily appearance is equally described by a moving sky
A22.note: The observation is true and ancient. It is the definition of a non-discriminating claim: both models predict it identically.

A23.name: Gravity / the heliocentric mechanism is unproven
A23.note: Voliva's 'gravity is a lot of rot.' Cavendish 1798 onward; g measured to nine significant figures.

A26.name: No orbital acceleration or rotation has ever been directly detected
A26.note: Contradicted by items the list itself includes: Michelson–Gale, Sagnac, ring-laser gyros, stellar aberration, parallax.

R01.name: General covariance permits a stationary-Earth frame
R01.note: CAREFUL CASE. The true part must be conceded: you may write physics in any coordinates. But coordinate freedom is not physical rest — in Earth-centred coordinates the rest of the universe acquires enormous fictitious forces, which is the observable difference.

R02.name: Mach's principle / relational mechanics allows a fixed Earth
R02.real_source: Ernst Mach, The Science of Mechanics (1883)
R02.note: Mach's principle is not a settled part of GR and does not privilege Earth in any case.

R03.name: No experiment detects absolute motion; only relative motion is observable
R03.note: Correct, and it cuts both ways: it equally forbids establishing that the Earth is absolutely at rest.

R04.name: The equivalence principle validates a local rest frame
R04.note: Local, not global. It says nothing about the Earth's state of motion relative to distant matter.

R05.name: GR admits rotating-universe solutions / frame dragging
R05.note: Gödel's universe is a mathematical solution incompatible with the observed cosmos. Frame dragging is real and measured — and is far too small to hold the stars in a daily circuit.

R06.name: Tensor/gauge/coordinate formalism can be written Earth-centred
R06.note: The largest single cluster in the list. Restates coordinate freedom in ~15 different technical vocabularies. All one argument, already answered at R01.

R07.name: Alternative gravity theories admit geocentric variants
R07.note: No specific variant, paper, or prediction is cited.

R08.name: Practical systems use Earth-fixed coordinates, therefore Earth is fixed
R08.note: The second-largest cluster. A reference frame is chosen for convenience — you navigate in the frame you stand in. WGS84 is an Earth-centred model *of an oblate rotating spheroid*; ECI-to-ECEF conversion contains Earth's rotation rate as an explicit term.

R09.name: Clock synchronisation / one-way light speed is conventional
R09.note: A real and respectable philosophy-of-physics point that has no geocentric consequence.

R10.name: Quantum observer-defined frames put the observer at the centre
R10.note: Equivocates on 'observer'. Quantum measurement is not about spatial centrality.

R11.name: No falsifier distinguishes the frames; multiple cosmologies fit the data
R11.note: Bouw — the movement's only credentialed astronomer — conceded his model is observationally equivalent to heliocentrism and must therefore be chosen on theological grounds. That concession removes the list's own claim to be scientific evidence.

R12.name: The Copernican principle is an unproven assumption
R12.note: It is not merely assumed — it is tested. The kSZ power spectrum rules out Gpc-scale off-centre void models.

B01.name: Water finds its level, therefore the surface is a plane
B01.note: Equivocates on 'level': a level surface is an equipotential surface, which on a rotating spheroid is curved. Newton derived the Earth's oblateness from that same premise in the Principia.

B02.name: The horizon is flat and rises to eye level
B02.note: Dip of horizon is measurable with a theodolite and grows with altitude.

B03.name: Bedford Level / laser canal tests show no curvature
B03.note: Rowbotham's two-point setup with a near-water sightline is the exact configuration in which refraction produces a false null. Wallace's three-point 1870 repeat and Oldham's 1901 replication both found the curvature. Flat-earthers cite the court voiding the *wager* as if it reversed the *measurement*.

B04.name: Long-range visibility of ships, lighthouses and towers
B04.originator_work: Zetetic Astronomy, 3rd ed. enl. (1881), ch. II
B04.note: Rowbotham reprints the Britannica “Levelling” article in the same chapter as his lighthouse table — it gives him the refraction mechanism, the one-seventh coefficient, and the variability that a flat plane cannot produce. Lady Blount's own 1904 photographer recorded the shimmering vapour layer that explains her result.

B05.name: Engineering makes no curvature allowance (canals, rail, pipelines, bridges)
B05.originator_work: One Hundred Proofs that the Earth Is Not a Globe
B05.note: Carpenter's proofs 3 and 40 (Suez Canal) reappear as Dubay's 7 and 8. Local works are built to the local equipotential — which *is* the curved surface. Long-baseline works (tunnels, geodetic survey, GNSS) explicitly model the ellipsoid.

B06.name: Surveyors assume a plane and make no 'allowance'
B06.note: Rowbotham's own '8 inches per mile squared' is lifted from a surveying text — real arithmetic for the difference between true and apparent level. He quoted the correction and then denied the thing it corrects for.

B07.name: Refraction is invoked ad hoc to rescue curvature
B07.note: Refraction is independently measurable, was described before the dispute, and is used in the same form by surveyors who are not arguing about Earth's shape.

B08.name: Star trails / Polaris fixed / southern circumpolar geometry
B08.originator_work: 200 Proofs Earth Is Not a Spinning Ball
B08.note: Southern-hemisphere circumpolar star trails around a *southern* pole are impossible on any single-plane model. This is the item the flat model most clearly gets wrong.

B09.name: Plumb lines are perpendicular everywhere
B09.note: Plumb lines point to the local gravity vector, which converges toward the centre. Measured by deflection-of-the-vertical surveys.

B10.name: Sun and Moon appear the same size; solar diameter constant
B10.note: Coincidence of angular size is real and well known. Solar angular diameter in fact varies ~3.4% annually — the reason we have both total and annular eclipses.

B11.name: Radar, LiDAR, photogrammetry and sonar assume a plane
B11.note: All of these run on ellipsoidal datums. Same convenience-frame error as R08.

B12.name: Polar navigation and dead reckoning imply a dome/disc
B12.note: Antarctic circumnavigation and the 24-hour midnight sun are incompatible with any disc model — as Jeran Campanella conceded on the December 2024 'Final Experiment' expedition.

B13.name: Mirage and optical ducting explain far sightings
B13.note: Conceding an atmospheric optical mechanism concedes the refraction answer the list elsewhere rejects (B07).

B14.name: Rocket and balloon footage shows a flat horizon
B14.note: Curvature is below the noise of a wide-angle lens at balloon altitude; the same footage at altitude with a rectilinear lens shows it.

C01.name: Proof-texts on an immovable, established Earth

C02.name: Proof-texts on a moving Sun
C02.note: Outside the testable domain. Reattributed 2026-08-02: Carpenter's 1885 pamphlet contains exactly ONE scriptural proof (#50, on immovability) and never mentions Joshua, Habakkuk or Ecclesiastes. The sun-motion proof-text corpus is a later accretion reaching its present shape in modern thematic compilations.

C05.name: Circle, four corners and ends of the Earth
C05.note: The list cites both 'four corners' and 'the circle of the Earth' as proofs. They describe different shapes.

C06.name: Anthropocentric creation / Earth as footstool
C06.note: A theological claim about purpose, not geometry.

C07.name: Patristic, scholastic and church-tradition affirmation
C07.note: Appeal to authority; also historically contested.

C08.name: Liturgy, calendar and eastward orientation as cosmology
C08.note: Ritual practice keyed to apparent sky motion is not a measurement of the sky.

C09.name: Church art and iconography as cosmology
C09.note: Devotional imagery is not survey data.

C10.name: Job 26:7 — 'he hangs the earth on nothing'
C10.note: Cited alongside the pillars-and-foundations texts (C03), which say the opposite. The list uses both as proofs.

D01.name: All ancient cultures were geocentric
D01.note: Appeal to antiquity. Also false in detail: Aristarchus proposed heliocentrism in the 3rd c. BCE, and Eratosthenes measured the Earth's circumference c. 240 BCE.

D02.name: Named ancient authorities (Plato, Aristotle, Ptolemy, Tycho)
D02.note: Every one of them held the Earth to be a *sphere*. Citing them supports geocentrism at best, and actively refutes the flat half of the list.

D03.name: Geocentric/Ptolemaic models made accurate predictions
D03.note: True, and the point: they were superseded *by measurement*, not by decree.

D04.name: Axis mundi / world tree / omphalos symbolism
D04.originator_work: The Myth of the Eternal Return
D04.real_source: Eliade 1949; Guénon, Le Roi du Monde 1927
D04.note: Eliade described religious *symbolism*, not geography — and Jonathan Z. Smith showed even the universality claim is a scholarly construct built on a misread of Spencer and Gillen.

D06.name: Hermetic 'as above, so below' / sacred geometry / microcosm
D06.real_source: Emerald Tablet, Arabic recensions c. 750–830 CE
D06.note: The maxim is a 12th-c. Latin rendering of an 8th–9th-c. Arabic alchemical text about transmutation — current in English occultism from Blavatsky (1877) and codified as a numbered Hermetic Principle by a 1908 Chicago New Thought pamphlet. It is not an Egyptian statement about the shape of the Earth.

D07.name: Kabbalistic / alchemical / Gnostic / Rosicrucian / Masonic iconography
D07.originator_work: The Secret Teachings of All Ages (1928); Isis Unveiled (1877)
D07.note: Esoteric interpretive literature. Where these traditions do carry cosmology it is the geocentric nested spheres of their own century — which contain a spherical Earth. Hall captions the Rosicrucian plate a “Ptolemaic chart”.

D08.name: Temple, cathedral and Dendera-zodiac architecture as cosmology
D08.originator_work: The Secret Teachings of All Ages
D08.real_source: Dendera zodiac, Louvre E 13482, dated c. 50 BCE
D08.note: The Dendera ceiling is a late-Ptolemaic *planisphere* incorporating the Babylonian/Greek zodiac — a projection of a spherical sky, and evidence of Hellenistic transmission rather than primordial hidden knowledge.

D09.name: Geocentric astrology and zodiacal symbolism as evidence
D09.note: Astrology is geocentric because it is observational and topocentric, not because the Earth is fixed.

D10.name: Heliocentrism has occult/masonic roots
D10.note: Genetic fallacy. Where an idea came from is not evidence about whether it is true.

D11.name: Perception is reliable; the observer defines the centre
D11.note: Rowbotham's founding move — 'observation is real, theory is imaginary'. It is the epistemology the whole genre rests on, and it is the thing actually being defended.

D12.name: Simplicity / common sense favours a fixed Earth
D12.note: Parsimony is not a measurement, and the flat/fixed model is not in fact simpler once it must account for the southern sky.

D13.name: Meaning, teleology and fine-tuning imply centrality
D13.note: A claim about significance, not position.

D14.name: Dark matter / dark energy / MOND are modern epicycles
D14.note: Rhetorically effective and substantively empty: an unexplained residual in a theory is not evidence for a specific alternative, least of all one with no quantitative model.

D15.name: The Galileo affair was scientific, not religious
D15.note: A history-of-science claim with no bearing on the Earth's motion either way.

D16.name: World mythologies depict a circling sun or a covering sky
D16.note: Myth records how the sky looks, which is not in dispute.

D17.name: An electromagnetic/toroidal dome centred on Earth
D17.real_source: Schumann resonance (real, and a consequence of a spherical cavity)
D17.note: Sargent's enclosed-world model. The Schumann resonance frequency is derived from the Earth-ionosphere cavity treated as a *sphere* of radius 6371 km — the number only comes out right on a globe.

D19.name: Eclipse and lunar cycles are tuned to human timekeeping
D19.note: Saros and Metonic cycles are consequences of orbital periods; the calendars were built to fit them, not the reverse.

E01.name: CMB 'Axis of Evil' aligns with Earth / the ecliptic
E01.real_source: Land & Magueijo 2005, PRL 95:071301; de Oliveira-Costa et al. 2004; Schwarz et al. 2004
E01.note: CAREFUL CASE — represent honestly. The alignment is a real, reproducible feature of the data and the significance debate is genuinely open. But Land & Magueijo themselves walked the significance back in 2007 ('no evidence' under Bayesian model comparison for the general model); Planck 2018 VII notes the look-elsewhere effect and finds no corresponding anomaly in polarization. Decisively: the axis aligns with the *ecliptic and the dipole*, which points to a local/systematic origin — i.e. the alignment is evidence the signal may be partly non-cosmological, which is the opposite of what is claimed.

E02.name: CMB hemispheric asymmetry, Cold Spot, parity and variance anomalies
E02.real_source: Planck 2018 VII, A&A 641:A7; Schwarz et al. 2016, CQG 33:184001
E02.note: Same status as E01: real features, contested significance, no geocentric implication.

E03.name: CMB dipole, dark flow and bulk-flow directionality
E03.real_source: Kashlinsky et al. 2008; Planck Int. XIII 2014, A&A 561:A97
E03.note: The dipole *is* our motion — 369.82 ± 0.11 km/s, measured. Dark flow was not confirmed: Planck found no detection of bulk flow in any comoving sphere.

E04.name: Quasar polarization alignment and large quasar groups
E04.real_source: Hutsemékers et al. 2005, A&A 441:915; Clowes et al. 2013, MNRAS 429:2910
E04.note: Real, replicated signals with an accepted astrophysical mechanism — black-hole spins align with the filaments they sit in. Preferred directions differ by redshift slice and hemisphere, so there is no single axis through Earth. Nadathur 2013 showed Clowes's algorithm finds Gpc 'structures' in explicitly homogeneous random simulations.

E05.name: Galaxy spin handedness / hemispheric bias
E05.note: The nearest thing to settled on this list. Galaxy Zoo found classifier bias; Iye et al. 2021 found a headline 4.0σ result collapsed to 0.29σ once duplicate entries were removed; Patel & Desmond 2024 pooled all public datasets and found consistency with isotropy.

E06.name: Dwarf-galaxy planes and satellite alignments
E06.note: A real ΛCDM tension that has substantially deflated; with Gaia proper motions the Milky Way plane looks transient rather than rotation-supported. No geocentric content either way.

E08.name: Pioneer and flyby anomalies are Earth-directed
E08.real_source: Anderson et al. 1998, PRL 81:2858; Turyshev et al. 2012, PRL 108:241101
E08.note: The Pioneer anomaly was resolved in 2012 — anisotropic thermal recoil. Nature Physics ran the farewell editorial. The flyby anomaly is an unreplicated 1990s Doppler-tracking puzzle with a decade of null results since; it is a navigation problem, not a cosmological one.

E09.name: Hubble tension shows we are at a special location
E09.real_source: Riess et al. 2022, ApJL 934:L7; Kenworthy et al. 2019, ApJ 875:145
E09.note: The local-void reading was tested directly on 1295 supernovae and excluded at 4–5σ. The tension is between two ways of measuring the same number, both of which assume an expanding homogeneous universe.

E10.name: Zodiacal dust and Kuiper structure show ecliptic symmetry
E10.note: Solar-system material lies in the solar-system plane. That is what a solar system is.

E11.name: The solar-system plane coincides with the CMB axis
E11.note: This is the E01 coincidence restated — and it is the strongest available hint that the CMB alignment is a local systematic.

E12.name: Redshift quantization in concentric shells around Earth
E12.note: Quantization disappeared as sample sizes grew; the effect was an artefact of small, sparse redshift samples.

E13.name: Supernova dimming, BAO, birefringence and Lyman-alpha anisotropy
E13.note: Named without a stated result or inference.

E14.name: Solar anomalies (oblateness, neutrinos, apex, barycentre wobble)
E14.note: The solar neutrino problem was solved by neutrino oscillation (SNO, 2001; Nobel 2015). The barycentre wobble is a *prediction* of the Sun being orbited by planets.

E15.name: VLBI, interferometry and Gaia reductions assume an Earth frame
E15.note: Same convenience-frame error as R08. VLBI is in fact one of the instruments that *measures* Earth orientation and rotation to microsecond precision.

E16.name: Meteor, bolide and micrometeor distributions
E16.note: Meteor-shower radiants and calendar fixity are consequences of Earth's orbit crossing debris streams — a heliocentric prediction.

E17.name: Observed isotropy / Earth-centred fields imply we are the centre
E17.note: Isotropy is observed from every vantage point in a homogeneous universe — that is the standard result, not an anomaly. The Earth's magnetosphere is Earth-centred because it is the Earth's field.

E18.name: Solar-system angular-momentum distribution problem
E18.note: A question in planetary-formation theory (magnetic braking, disc transport), not evidence about Earth's motion.
